conviction_note: Near-coin-flip direction on a name that moves a median ~10-14% on its own report days (2025-26 observed: +24.2, +14.2, +6.7, +9.8, -19.1, +9.6, -32.7). A lowered sell-side bar (Redeye trimmed on 3 Nov, stock -8.3% that day) and a 4.47% short that is covering lean slightly up. A direct peer's Jul-Sep production fell 7% QoQ and cash burn remains the open question, and those offset it. So abs_move 12 with p_up 53 gives +0.72, and the findings sum to +0.2. The two measurements agree in sign and roughly in size.

already_public.what: No profit warning (vinstvarning) or pre-release in the issuer's Nasdaq Nordic feed since the Q2 report. Latest items are design wins (26 Oct, 9 Nov SEK 75m Korean OEM).
Q2 2026: net sales SEK 140.9m (+53%), Automotive organic +128%, EBITDA SEK 27m, FCF -23.8m, available cash incl. facilities SEK 117.7m, SEK 300m bond outstanding (STIBOR+7%).
CEO (Di interview): no further capital raise planned; expects a clear cash-flow improvement in Q4, cash flow near zero and a positive EBIT.
Redeye Q3 preview: seasonally lower European volumes offset most of the GSR take-rate gain. Automotive estimates trimmed, model rebuilt for the IFRS transition.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 net sales and Automotive license revenue. Likely roughly flat QoQ around SEK 135-145m on summer seasonality (peer Seeing Machines' Jul-Sep production -7% QoQ), still strongly up YoY against SEK 99.1m. Sign versus the trimmed Redeye bar unknown.

Q3 FCF probably still negative and available cash below Q2's SEK 117.7m. Accrued (not yet invoiced) revenue was SEK 147.6m at Q2. Cash conversion is the line most likely to decide the reaction. Slight negative risk.
No formal guidance. Whether the report repeats the CEO's Q4 'cash flow near zero, positive EBIT' path or softens it is the key qualitative line. Unknown.
First report on IFRS (per Redeye), with restated comparatives. Removing goodwill amortisation flatters EBIT optically. Mildly positive optics, mostly understood.

bar: Redeye (the main covering house) Q3 estimates, trimmed on 2026-11-03 (https://www.borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FB3D6). The SEK figures are not in any accessible source, so the bar is not numerically sourced and every size is capped small.
session_check: bmo. The issuer's financial calendar lists Interim Report Q3 2026 on 17 Nov 2026 (https://smarteye.se/investors/financial-calendar/), MFN lists 2026-11-17 07:00 Kvartalsrapport 2026-Q3 (https://mfn.se/a/smart-eye), and every prior report was released at 07:00 Stockholm (Q2 2026 at 2026-08-26 07:00 CEST per the Nasdaq Nordic feed).
positioning_check: The baseline's 0.0 is wrong: a name-join failure, not a truncated zero. Finansinspektionen's aggregate register (GetBlankningsregisterAggregat, read 2026-11-16) lists 'Smart Eye Aktiebolag (publ)' at 4.47% with a latest position date of 2026-11-13. The repo's own cache had 5.76% on 2026-09-17, so the short is COVERING into the print. The per-holder current file shows Qube 1.17% (2026-11-11, down from a 2.56% peak on 2026-08-26), GSA 0.70% (2026-10-19) and Citadel Securities 0.54% (2026-11-13). These are quant and market-making books, not a fundamental short. At ~4.5% of shares and roughly SEK 8m a day of turnover, it is several days of volume.

findings.finding: A disclosed net short of 4.47% (FI aggregate, 2026-11-13) is still large against turnover but has fallen from 5.76% in mid-September, with Qube cutting from 2.56% to 1.17%. Shorts are covering into the print, and the residual is fuel on any upside surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short built from ~2% to ~6% after the Q2 crash (EFN/Holdings). The stock's up-days on reports (Q4 2024 +24.2%, Q1 2025 +14.2%) came off smaller short books. No observed squeeze on this name.
findings.original_quote: Smart Eye Aktiebolag (publ) | 549300BUD7ZPFPKM6856 | 4,47 | 2026-11-13 (aggregerad kort nettoposition i procent / aggregated net short position in per cent)
findings.why_not_priced: The stage's sealed baseline itself reads 0.0 because the register join missed the issuer name. A reader using that pipeline sees no short at all. The covering trend shows only in the per-holder FI file, which is not wire copy.
findings.independence: EFN 2026-09-17 (https://efn.se/blankningen-rusar-i-smaspararfavoriten) independently reports the short rising from about 2% to 6%, a record, per Holdings.

findings.finding: Seeing Machines, the direct DMS royalty peer, reported Jul-Sep 2026 (its Q1 FY2027) production of 1,963,046 units against 2,112,855 in Apr-Jun, a 7% QoQ fall. This suggests Smart Eye's Q3 license volumes were also seasonally flat-to-down QoQ despite the GSR mandate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Automotive royalty growth decides this stock. Q2's +128% against a sell-side ~200% expectation produced -32.7% on the day. A Seeing Machines beat before that print had lifted the bar, so the peer read is known to transmit into expectations here.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Redeye trimmed on 3 Nov on the same seasonality argument and the stock fell 8.3% that day. The Seeing Machines number came six days later, and the stock rose 3% on 9 Nov on a design win, so the peer data itself drew no visible reaction. A proxy. Smart Eye's OEM mix (13 European OEMs) differs from Seeing Machines', so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Redeye Q3 preview (https://www.borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FB3D6) expects seasonally lower European volumes to offset much of the GSR gain.

findings.finding: The bar has been reset lower. After Redeye's ~200% Automotive growth forecast caused the Q2 'miss', the CEO said he should have managed analyst expectations better and that Q2 was 'very close to our own expectations'. Redeye then trimmed its Q3 Automotive estimates 'to be on the cautious side'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 missed Redeye by SEK 29.2m in net sales and fell 32.7%. Q1 2026 rose 9.6% and Q4 2025 fell 19.1%, so the reaction is to the gap against the single covering house, and it is large.
findings.original_quote: "Med facit i hand skulle vi ha gjort ett bättre jobb med att styra analytikernas förväntningar, för utvecklingen låg väldigt nära våra egna förväntningar" (With hindsight we would have done a better job of steering analysts' expectations, because the development was very close to our own expectations)
findings.why_not_priced: The trim is public and drew -8.3% on 3 Nov. What may not be priced is that the company has a motive to have pre-steered Redeye toward its own internal number, which makes a large miss against a 'cautious' bar less likely than Q2's. Inference only, with an unsourced numerical bar, so capped small.
findings.independence: Redeye Q2 initial take (https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00EA64D) confirms the Q2 miss was entirely Automotive with OPEX in line. Redeye Q3 preview (https://www.borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FB3D6) confirms the trim.

findings.finding: Cash conversion is still the weak line. Q2 FCF was SEK -23.8m in the company's strongest quarter, cash fell 36% in H1 to SEK 85.9m (117.7m incl. facilities), and accrued, not-yet-invoiced revenue rose 49% to SEK 147.6m. A seasonally soft Q3 makes a further negative FCF likely, against the CEO's public claim of near-zero cash flow in Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EFN attributes part of the Q2 -32.7% to weak cash flow. The company has run six share issues in ten years (Affärsvärlden via Finwire, 2026-09-03), so cash is the line the holder base punishes.
findings.original_quote: "En detalj att hålla ögonen på är posten upplupna intäkter ... Den har vuxit 49% sedan årsskiftet till 147,6 Mkr. Royaltyboomen syns i resultaträkningen men har ännu inte nått bankkontot." (A detail to watch is accrued revenue ... it has grown 49% since year-end to SEK 147.6m. The royalty boom shows in the income statement but has not yet reached the bank account.)
findings.why_not_priced: The cash worry is public and was part of the Q2 crash. The CEO's 15 Oct claim of Q4 cash flow near zero is a new, checkable statement the Q3 release will either support (accrued revenue converting, positive WC) or undercut. A financing question rather than a verdict: the SEK 300m bond runs to Dec 2028 and there is no maturity in the window. Sized as a two-sided item with a negative lean.
findings.independence: EFN 2026-09-17 (https://efn.se/blankningen-rusar-i-smaspararfavoriten): 'Investerarna tycktes oroa sig för det svaga kassaflödet' (investors seemed to worry about the weak cash flow). Q2 report cash-flow table (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a3952d62dcb77211494ae14b307ecd013).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is likely the first report under IFRS, with Redeye having rebuilt its model for it. Ending K3 goodwill amortisation (acquisition surplus-value amortisation was SEK 25.6m in Q1 under the old basis) lifts reported EBIT, making a 'positive EBIT' headline nearer than on the old basis.
findings.why_not_priced: An accounting change, mostly understood by the one covering analyst. Headline optics can still move a retail-heavy register (22,000 holders, Avanza median holding SEK 4,000 per EFN). Timing of the first IFRS report and the exact goodwill share are inferred, not confirmed by the company, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Design wins announced since the Q2 report (17 Jul SEK 15m, 13 Aug ~SEK 100m, 27 Aug SEK 15m, 26 Oct cabin monitoring add-on, 9 Nov SEK 75m Korean OEM; 382 design wins in total) will lift the reported order value above Q2's SEK 9,015m. This answers the 'backlog standing still' criticism, but every component is already public.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A stagnant order value (8,850 to 9,015) was cited as a reason for the Q2 fall (Placera 2026-08-26).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: every win was released through the regulated channel. It is kept at near zero only because the aggregate order-value number in the report is the line the Q2 critics watched.
findings.independence: Placera 2026-08-26 (https://placera.se/nyheter/rekordtillvaxt-racker-inte--smart-eye-rasar-2026-08-26) on order value standing still.

language_note: Swedish press (Di via Placera/Finwire, 2026-10-15) carried the CEO's post-crash admission on expectation management and his Q4 'kassaflöde kring noll, positivt ebit' target. No English source found carried it.
Swedish press (Placera 2026-08-26) carried the accrued-revenue (upplupna intäkter +49% to SEK 147.6m) cash-conversion point. The English release and the Redeye summaries did not highlight it.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': design-win / order-value finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'understatement is the systematic error': abs_move_pct raised from 11 to 12 on the observed report-day distribution; p_up unchanged at 53
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' confirmed keeping the cash-flow finding at -1.0. It did not resize it, so the lesson is not applied twice
